name: Self Injury
overview: Scripture clearly prohibits self-inflicted wounds as seen in Leviticus 19:28, where God commands His people not to make cuttings in their flesh. The example of Job scraping himself with a potsherd in his suffering (Job 2:8) demonstrates human frailty but does not endorse self-injury. Instead, God draws near to those who are brokenhearted and contrite in spirit, offering comfort and salvation (Psalms 34:18). The everlasting God, who never grows weary or faint, is the ultimate source of strength and understanding for those struggling with pain (Isaiah 40:28).
